dos.text: Set the value HTML attribute (not just the JS property) before the element connects if you need form-reset to return to a specific default, connectedCallback captures getAttribute("value") || this.value as defaultValue exactly once, at connection time.

donts.text: Don't set both description and ariaDescription expecting both to apply, inputTemplate() only emits aria-description when hasDescription is false, so a visible description silently wins and your ariaDescription is dropped.
